messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a tiled walkway, raises one hand to her head, places the other hand on her hip, then turns slightly to face the camera while touching her face and hair.","camera":"A static, slightly elevated three-quarter view from behind the character, keeping her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting dress with a colorful abstract pattern of purple, blue, pink, and orange shapes, plus red flat shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short hair tied into a small high ponytail or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A slender female 3D character with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor paved area with glossy light-colored tiles on the left, a rougher textured ground on the right, and large pale structures in the background under warm, low-angle sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sandy outdoor area to the reference tiled walkway with rough textured ground and pale structures. The character remains in the same pose sequence and similar centered framing, with warm low-angle lighting consistent with the new scene. Her dress pattern, blue hair, and red shoes are retained, though the shoes appear darker/more maroon in the output.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference setting, place the person in that environment, keep identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserve camera framing/movement, and adapt the person's lighting to the target environment.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was fully preserved, since her face is mostly not visible in the source and only briefly visible in the output.
unexpected_changes: The character's shoes appear darker/more maroon in the output than the pinkish shoes in the source.
